with open('/app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs', 'a') as f:
    f.write('    fn parse_select_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<(ast::Expression, Option<String>)>> {\n')
    f.write('        let mut expressions = Vec::new();\n')
    f.write('        loop {\n')
    f.write('            let expr = self.parse_expression()?;\n')
    f.write('            let alias = if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::As)) {\n')
    f.write('                Some(self.next_ident()?)\n')
    f.write('            } else if self.peek()?.map_or(false, |t| matches!(t, Token::Ident(_))) {\n')
    f.write('                match self.peek()? {\n')
    f.write('                    Some(Token::Ident(name)) => {\n')
    f.write('                        self.next();\n')
    f.write('                        Some(name.clone())\n')
    f.write('                    }\n')
    f.write('                    _ => None,\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('            } else {\n')
    f.write('                None\n')
    f.write('            };\n')
    f.write('            expressions.push((expr, alias));\n')
    f.write('            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) {\n')
    f.write('                break;\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(expressions)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_from_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<ast::From>> {\n')
    f.write('        let mut tables = Vec::new();\n')
    f.write('        tables.push(self.parse_from_table()?);\n')
    f.write('        while self.next_is(Token::Comma) || self.next_if_map(|t| match t {\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Inner) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Left) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Right) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Cross) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Outer) => Some(()),\n')
    f.write('            _ => None,\n')
    f.write('        }).is_some() {\n')
    f.write('            if self.next_is(Token::Comma) {\n')
    f.write('                tables.push(self.parse_from_table()?);\n')
    f.write('            } else {\n')
    f.write('                let join_type = self.parse_from_join()?;\n')
    f.write('                if let Some(join_type) = join_type {\n')
    f.write('                    let right = self.parse_from_table()?;\n')
    f.write('                    let left = tables.pop().unwrap();\n')
    f.write('                    let predicate = if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::On)) {\n')
    f.write('                        Some(self.parse_expression()?)\n')
    f.write('                    } else {\n')
    f.write('                        None\n')
    f.write('                    };\n')
    f.write('                    tables.push(ast::From::Join { left: Box::new(left), right: Box::new(right), r#type: join_type, predicate });\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(tables)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_from_table(&mut self) -> Result<ast::From> {\n')
    f.write('        let name = self.next_ident()?;\n')
    f.write('        let alias = if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::As)) {\n')
    f.write('            Some(self.next_ident()?)\n')
    f.write('        } else if self.peek()?.map_or(false, |t| matches!(t, Token::Ident(_))) {\n')
    f.write('            match self.peek()? {\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Ident(name)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    Some(name.clone())\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                _ => None,\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        } else {\n')
    f.write('            None\n')
    f.write('        };\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::From::Table { name, alias })\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_from_join(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::JoinType>> {\n')
    f.write('        if self.next_is(Token::Comma) {\n')
    f.write('            return Ok(Some(ast::JoinType::Cross));\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        let join_type = if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Cross)) {\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join))?;\n')
    f.write('            ast::JoinType::Cross\n')
    f.write('        } else if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Inner)) {\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join))?;\n')
    f.write('            ast::JoinType::Inner\n')
    f.write('        } else if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Left)) {\n')
    f.write('            if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Outer)) {\n')
    f.write('                self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join))?;\n')
    f.write('            } else {\n')
    f.write('                self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join))?;\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            ast::JoinType::Left\n')
    f.write('        } else if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Right)) {\n')
    f.write('            if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Outer)) {\n')
    f.write('                self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join))?;\n')
    f.write('            } else {\n')
    f.write('                self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join))?;\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            ast::JoinType::Right\n')
    f.write('        } else if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Join)) {\n')
    f.write('            ast::JoinType::Inner\n')
    f.write('        } else {\n')

    f.write('        };\n')
    f.write('        Ok(Some(join_type))\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
print('Part 5 done')
